title: IH-THREAD-MASTER-GRAPH-PROJECTION-GUARD-V1
retrievalQuestions: Should Master Graph store extracted project values?
What must be persisted before graph contribution?

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: A project extraction lane proposes Master Graph participation.
startAt: Identify the authoritative operational IDs and systems first.
runPreflight: Validate repository participation and contribution-envelope schemas.
doNot: Do not make Master Graph the primary operational database.
Do not contribute unpersisted or guessed IDs.
Do not copy full OCR payloads into canonical graph truth.
proveBeforeClaiming: Graph compile and publish receipts exist.
